'''Hodor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Baron/Legends|baron]] of<ref name="SWG" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. He was thought to have been the inventor of [[Pikatta Pie]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hodor was mentioned in the item description for Pikatta Pie in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
